name: Jipeng Li
description: Jipeng Li — research on learned representations, generative models, and reliable decisions; photographs of landscapes, wildlife, and life on the road.
research_intro: I study what learned representations tell us about model behavior, and whether they preserve the information needed for reliable decisions.
bio: I am a Ph.D. student at the University of California, Irvine, working with Yanning Shen. My research interests include learned representations, generative models, and reliable decision-making.
Before joining UCI, I completed my M.S. at the University of California, Davis.
Outside research, I photograph landscapes, wildlife, and the places I pass through. This website brings those two parts of my life together.
